title: Avomi CLIQ Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill - Blackcurrant Passionfruit
description: Built for the Avomi Cliq Prefilled Pod Kit, Avomi Cliq Prefilled Pods provide straightforward MTL (mouth-to-lung) performance with consistent flavour. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill container to extend use. Mesh coil technology supports crisp flavour and steady vapour, while the push-to-refill system keeps reloading tidy and quick — connect pod and refill, then attach to your Cliq device. Get up to around 6000 puffs per pack depending on usage, with 20mg Nicotine Salt for a smooth draw. Blackcurrant Passionfruit blends deep, dark Blackcurrant with a brighter Passionfruit note for a sweet-tart mix that stays lively without tasting sharp. Once your pod and refill is empty, simply swap them out for a fresh Avomi Cliq Prefilled Pod + Refill pack, View the full range of Avomi Cliq Prefilled pod kits & Refill Pods
